declarations.description:
Small "Are you sure?" popup anchored to the button that asked for it: delete a row, revoke a key, discard a draft.
The trigger goes in the `trigger` slot; clicking it opens the popup with a heading, an optional description and a
Cancel / OK pair. It asks for the one action that trigger stands for, so it suits a single destructive button; for a
decision that needs more room, or one not tied to a button, use `c2-modal`.

It looks like `c2-tooltip`: a compact dark bubble with an arrow pointing at the trigger, rather than a dialog. It is
a non-modal `alertdialog` in the top layer (`popover="manual"`), placed beside the trigger by floating-ui and flipped
when there is no room, so a scrolling or `overflow: hidden` ancestor never clips it. Opening it moves focus to
Cancel, the least destructive choice, so a stray Enter does not confirm.

Every opening a user starts ends in exactly one `confirm` or `cancel` event: OK fires `confirm`; Cancel, Escape, a
click outside and moving focus elsewhere fire `cancel`. `confirm` is cancelable: call `preventDefault()` to keep the
popup open while the action runs, set `pending` to show it, then set `open` back to `false` when it is done. Setting
`open` from code fires `show` / `hide` only.

Once opened, the trigger (or the button inside a `c2-*` trigger) carries `aria-haspopup="dialog"` and
`aria-expanded`. Nothing is written before the first opening, so server-rendered markup hydrates unchanged.

cssParts.description: The arrow pointing at the trigger.
cssParts.name: arrow

cssParts.description: The text region wrapping the `heading` slot; it shows the `heading` attribute as fallback and is hidden when both are empty.
cssParts.name: heading

cssParts.name: description

cssParts.description: The icon region wrapping the `icon` slot: the warning sign by default, or the assigned icon.

slots.description: The button that asks for confirmation. Clicking it toggles the popup.
slots.name: trigger

slots.description: The question, e.g. "Delete this task?". Overrides the `heading` attribute.
slots.name: heading

slots.description: Optional description below the heading: what happens and whether it can be undone.
Icon beside the heading. Defaults to a warning sign; slot an empty element to remove it.
slots.name: icon

members.name: heading
members.description: The question the popup asks. The `heading` slot overrides it.

members.name: confirmLabel
members.description: Text of the button that confirms.

members.name: cancelLabel
members.description: Text of the button that cancels.

members.name: placement
members.description: Preferred side of the trigger; flips when there is no room.

members.name: open
members.description: Visible state. Set it to open or close the popup from code; that fires `show` / `hide` but no `confirm` or `cancel`.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Keeps the trigger from opening the popup. The trigger itself stays usable unless it is disabled too.

members.name: pending
members.description:
The confirmed action is running: OK shows as busy and ignores clicks, Cancel and Escape still close. Set it from a
`confirm` listener that called `preventDefault()`, then close with `open = false`.

members.name: trigger
members.description: The first element in the `trigger` slot.

members.name: dismiss
members.description: Closes as the user's choice not to go ahead.

members.name: syncTriggerAria
members.description: `aria-haspopup` / `aria-expanded` belong on the element with the button role: inside a `c2-*` trigger, its control.

events.name: cancel
events.description: The user dismissed the popup: Cancel, Escape, a click outside or focus moving away.
The user chose OK. Cancelable: `preventDefault()` keeps the popup open.
